en: Sepia-toned postcard-style photograph showing a large crowd of formally dressed men and women, many in dark coats and hats, walking and standing in front of a neoclassical building with tall Corinthian columns and multiple rectangular windows. The scene appears to be a civic or ceremonial gathering in an urban square beside the building. Trees without leaves are visible to the right, suggesting autumn or winter. No visible printed caption or handwritten text is present on the front.
